get.summary: Tenant admin for audit; otherwise active member — GET /tenants/{id}/usage
get.description: Authentication: configured issuer/audience JWT. Authorization: Tenant admin for audit; otherwise active member. Tenant path is authoritative where present; control operations use explicit authorization. Mutation retries: registration/provisioning/membership inserts/deduplicated webhooks converge; project/task/report creates accept optional tenant/actor/route/canonical-payload-bound Idempotency-Key for seven days; conflicting reuse returns409. Optional project If-Match rejects stale updates412. Existing project names are unique per tenant. Errors never expose database constraint details. API fields: api_confirmed confirmed accepted attempts; api/api_reserved includes durable hard-cap reservations; api_inflight_or_indeterminate is their difference. Reservations are not a final invoice ledger. api_assumed reports conservatively settled uncertain consumption; api_inflight_or_indeterminate excludes that separately reported amount. This is not an invoicing ledger.
